training.purpose: maintain the House Tang Tang Champion qualification and elite formation readiness without tying the rank to one commander
development_rules: verified training exposure and development remain cohort-level for ordinary Tang Champions
cohort growth uses the same evidence-based age aptitude capability health recovery and diminishing-return principles adapted to distributions
promotion from Guardian Cavalry transfers conserved aggregate headcount and does not create a per-soldier identity registry
an individually important Champion may later materialize exactly once from the cohort; assignment-specific training never changes House Tang ownership or duplicates personnel
